columns.name: Discount
columns.description: Discount rate applied to the order line

measures.name: Running Sales
measures.expression: CALCULATE(SUM('Orders'[Sales]), WINDOW(1, ABS, 0, REL, ALLSELECTED('Orders'[Order Date Quarter Start]), ORDERBY('Orders'[Order Date Quarter Start])))

measures.name: Selected Metric
measures.expression: SWITCH([Metric Selector Value], "Sales", SUM('Orders'[Sales]), "Profit", SUM('Orders'[Profit]), SUM('Orders'[Quantity]))

tables.name: Orders
tables.m:
let
    Source = Sql.Database(#"Superstore Server", #"Superstore Database"),
    Data = Source{[Schema = "dbo", Item = "Orders"]}[Data],
    Selected = Table.SelectColumns(Data, {"row_id", "order_id", "order_date", "ship_date", "ship_mode", "customer_id", "product_id", "sales", "quantity", "discount", "profit"}, MissingField.UseNull),
    Renamed = Table.RenameColumns(Selected, {{"row_id", "Row ID"}, {"order_id", "Order ID"}, {"order_date", "Order Date"}, {"ship_date", "Ship Date"}, {"ship_mode", "Ship Mode"}, {"customer_id", "Customer ID"}, {"product_id", "Product ID"}, {"sales", "Sales"}, {"quantity", "Quantity"}, {"discount", "Discount"}, {"profit", "Profit"}}),
    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Renamed, {{"Row ID", Int64.Type}, {"Order ID", type text}, {"Order Date", type date}, {"Ship Date", type date}, {"Ship Mode", type text}, {"Customer ID", type text}, {"Product ID", type text}, {"Sales", type number}, {"Quantity", Int64.Type}, {"Discount", type number}, {"Profit", type number}})
in
    Typed

columns.name: Customer Lifetime Sales
columns.expression: (VAR __lod1 = RELATED('Customers'[Customer Name]) RETURN CALCULATE(SUM('Orders'[Sales]), REMOVEFILTERS(), 'Customers'[Customer Name] = __lod1))
